name: smartcompact
description: A Claude Code mod that compacts the conversation at the right moment with a summary focused on the current task, and then picks the work back up.

minTokens.title: Token floor
minTokens.description: Tokens added since the first turn of the session, or since the first turn after a compaction, before the session is nudged to compact, the judge is asked or a session's own request compacts.

claudeModel.title: Claude judge model
claudeModel.description: Model alias or id for the Claude judge. It runs through Claude Code's own model call.
